Does it work without the internet?: Does it work without the internet?
Yes. Reachable peers on the same LAN can: Yes. Reachable peers on the same LAN can discover each other and exchange encrypted messages without internet access or a central server. Your network must allow local discovery and peer connections.
Can I talk to people on another network?: Can I talk to people on another network?
Yes, when an existing routed path connec: Yes, when an existing routed path connects you, or through opted-in, trusted post-office bridges. Mesh-Talk does not provide a VPN or join IP subnets.
What happens when someone is offline?: What happens when someone is offline?
An optional peer-operated post office ca: An optional peer-operated post office can temporarily hold recipient-encrypted events, subject to capacity and a 30-day maximum age. Authorized peers can also help recover retained group history after reconnection. Delivery depends on available paths and retained data.
Message content is end-to-end encrypted. Compare a contact’s safety number through a trusted channel to verify their identity. Peers and relays still observe some connection and routing metadata.
